description: Change log rotation size in an INI file, trailing semicolon comment. DISTILL-CANARY-041036c3

files.etc/logrotate.ini:
[app]
max_size_mb = 100    ; rotate when exceeded
keep_files = 7
compress = yes

[audit]
max_size_mb = 100    ; rotate when exceeded
keep_files = 30
compress = yes

turns.prompt: Audit logs grow faster; raise the audit section's max_size_mb to 250 in etc/logrotate.ini and leave the app section.

etc/logrotate.ini.equals:
[app]
max_size_mb = 100    ; rotate when exceeded
keep_files = 7
compress = yes

[audit]
max_size_mb = 250    ; rotate when exceeded
keep_files = 30
compress = yes
